input.composition: Pinned accepted city only. PR #51 and PR #52 candidate geometry is not composed into this input.

implementation.scope: Static exterior geometry: FootTown shell, lower lift enclosure, turning stairs, roof access, leg/base connection details, open upper lift support frame, guide members, two small rescue landings and illustrative stationary cars.
not_implemented: Lift operation, mechanical engineering, structural verification or animation
Surveyed reconstruction of the building, foundations or tower profile
FootTown shop interiors, signs or exact current floor plan
Interior doors or a verified walkable route from the stair termination through the main deck
Relocation of the inherited main deck or top deck

sources.title: フットタウン
claims: The main-deck elevator boarding area is on FootTown 1F.
The roof has an entrance to the outdoor stairs and an open area beneath the tower steelwork.
The current guide lists 1F, 2F, 3F, 5F, RF and BF; it does not establish the model's four equal-height facade storeys.

sources.title: メインデッキ行き昇り階段
claims: The outdoor stair route begins on the FootTown roof and reaches the main deck.
The operator describes the route as approximately 600 steps.

visual_references.view: From the roof floor toward the stair entrance; compass bearing not stated.
visual_references.observed: Broad grey roof floor, a small entrance structure, red stairs beyond the doorway and separate exterior tower trusses.

visual_references.view: Inside the outdoor stair route; position and compass bearing not stated.
visual_references.observed: Red turning stair flights, landings, handrails and mesh guards with daylight outside.

visual_references.view: Operator FootTown page header montage; right panel looks upward from beneath the tower, compass bearing not stated.
visual_references.observed: A narrow central vertical stair/lift assembly, separated from the large outer lattice by open air, below the main-deck underside.

unconfirmed: Exact number and arrangement of flights
Exact guard construction throughout the route

sources.title: 東京タワー 導入事例
sources.publisher: 三菱電機ビルソリューションズ株式会社
claims: The main-deck to top-deck elevator is an outdoor observation elevator installed within existing tower steelwork.
The renewal added two intermediate rescue-floor entrances.
The renewed car has two glazed faces and a mirrored ceiling.

visual_references.credit: 株式会社東京タワー, as credited by the article
visual_references.view: Near a tower corner, looking steeply upward; compass bearing not stated.
visual_references.observed: Dark reddish-brown FootTown exterior, light narrow coping, roof railing and a raised roof enclosure; outer orange legs span over the building, with a slim grey/glazed central lift assembly.

visual_references.view: From inside the upper observation car, looking outward and upward; compass bearing not stated.
visual_references.observed: Orange vertical, horizontal and diagonal members, vertical guide/rope-like members and sky beyond; this is not a dimensioned exterior survey.

sources.title: 東京タワー向け屋外展望用エレベーター
sources.locator: 三菱電機技報 Vol.92 No.9 (2018), printed pages 21-24; PDF pages 23-26
claims: The specific upper observation elevator has no hoistway wall, as stated on printed page 22.
The published elevator travel is approximately 85m; this is travel distance, not a surveyed total support-frame height.
The article describes outdoor exposure and the renewed car's use of glazing.
unconfirmed: A full current exterior elevation of the lift assembly

sources.title: 東京タワー耐震改修工事報告
sources.publisher: 宮地エンジニアリング
sources.locator: 宮地技報 No.28, printed pages 64-70; overall elevation on printed page 65 (PDF page 2)
claims: The overall elevation distinguishes wide outer legs and lower arches from the narrow central lift assembly and the building below.
The central upper vertical system is identified for elevator-shaft steel reinforcement between the observation-deck regions.
The diagram labels H11 as GL+120.000m, H23 as GL+223.500m, H27 as GL+252.650m and the top as GL+333.000m.
limitations: The diagram includes construction stages and temporary equipment; these are not all permanent external features.
The meaning of the difference between H11/H23 GL labels and the operator's 150m/250m deck descriptions was not established from primary evidence.
Do not reinterpret the diagram labels as surveyed deck-floor heights or move the inherited decks on that basis.

sources.title: 魅力再生 リニューアル事例 東京タワー
claims: FootTown is identified as reinforced concrete in the building outline.
The page describes maintenance and reinforcement of tower steelwork and foundations.
unconfirmed: Visible base plate and bolt dimensions

sources.title: タワペディア
claims: The operator describes main deck and top deck as 150m and 250m respectively.
Tower foundations extend below ground at each leg; this source does not establish the model's exposed pedestal shape.
The tower's paint colours are international orange and white.
unconfirmed: Equivalence of promotional deck heights to the model's local Z coordinates

model_estimates.classification: All values below are local scene-fit values, inherited approximations or visual estimates, not measurements from the cited sources.

foottown.basis: Retained legacy model footprint; not confirmed by a dimensioned primary drawing.
foottown.roof_opening_basis: A central square opening clears the modeled lower lift envelope; its dimensions are a scene-fit choice, not surveyed roof geometry.

roof_access_doorway.basis: An opening in the stair-entry enclosure; side and dimensions are inferred, not a verified real-world entrance orientation.

stairs.basis: 46 x 13 = 598 is a modeling choice consistent with an approximately 600-step route; it is not a claim that the real staircase has exactly 598 steps.
stairs.termination: The final tread matches the inherited Photo based main deck floor level at Z=145.1m and terminates within the central equipment region. No interior doorway or verified walkable route is modeled.

lower_lift.basis: Slim framed/glazed exterior envelope inferred from photographs and fitted to the retained roof and main-deck geometry.

upper_lift.basis: Open appearance is sourced; width, support intervals, guide details, plan centering and connections to existing tower members are inferred.
upper_lift.rescue_landing_basis: Count is sourced; model elevations, layout, platform size and railings are illustrative estimates.
upper_lift.rope_basis: Only the segment above the illustrative upper car roof is drawn to avoid passing through the car. This is static exterior detail, not a complete operational rope system.

model_estimates.cars: Illustrative stationary exterior envelopes; pose and dimensions are not operational specifications.
model_estimates.base_connections: Small plates and fasteners fitted to inherited leg/pedestal joints; size, number and geometry are unverified visual detail. No underground foundation reconstruction.
model_estimates.decks: Inherited deck positions and geometry are retained. The differing published height conventions remain unresolved.
model_estimates.inherited_main_deck_interface: In the pinned city, the old tower main-deck floor is absent and the Photo based main deck interior omits a central floor region of approximately +/-9m. This is a description of the inherited model, not a claim about the real building. The exterior stairs end inside that equipment region; interior circulation remains outside this revision.

evidence_limits: No site measurement or geodetic survey was performed.
Photo viewpoints have no verified compass bearing and do not supply calibrated dimensions.
No close current primary-source exterior photograph covering the complete upper lift frame was obtained.
Published existence and appearance do not establish structural adequacy, accessible circulation or safe lift operation.
Technical validation and matched comparison images must be recorded separately; this source record does not claim completed validation or human acceptance.

comparison_plan.status: Comparison rendering and validation results are recorded separately after completion.

distribution.reference_media: Third-party photographs and PDFs are reference-only and are not included in this repository or distributed with the model.
distribution.permission: Public accessibility is not a redistribution licence. This record grants no rights to reference media or the full legacy city.
distribution.model_textures: Reference photographs are not embedded or used as distributed textures.
